entities.name: John F. Seiberling
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: John Frederick Seiberling, Jr. was a United States representative from Ohio. In 1974, he helped to establish what later became the Cuyahoga Valley National Park, and served on the House Judiciary Committee that held the impeachment hearings against President Richard Nixon.
